Let $H$ and its entrywise square both be complex Hadamard matrices, and fix two distinct rows. If the cubes of their six entrywise ratios take only two distinct values, then the sum of the row-ratio terms over either specified cube fiber is zero.” “This is a supporting Fourier cancellation statement. exact_statement:
lemma rowRatio_cubeFiber_sum_zero {H : Matrix6} (hH : IsComplexHadamard H)
    (hs : IsComplexHadamard (entrywiseSquare H)) {i j : Index} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (a b : ℂ) (hne : a ≠ b)
    (hab : ∀ k, rowRatio H i j k ^ 3 = a ∨ rowRatio H i j k ^ 3 = b) :
    ∑ k ∈ cubeFiber (rowRatio H i j) a, H i k * star (H j k) = 0
